scenarios.name: Gateway Timeout During Authorization
scenarios.description: Breaker failure incremented, alternate card gateway completes, <2s latency, double-charge rule verified.

scenarios.name: Duplicate Webhook Delivery 3x
scenarios.description: Identical payment.captured ingested 3x, all HTTP 200, exactly 1 state transition, 0 duplicate charges.

scenarios.name: Double Submit Under High Concurrency
scenarios.description: Concurrent identical Idempotency-Key requests handled safely, exactly 1 transaction created.

scenarios.name: 502 During Capture with Exponential Backoff
scenarios.description: PayU 502 backoff (1s, 2s, 4s), late gateway status check, terminal CAPTURE_FAILED upon exhaustion.

scenarios.name: Partial Capture and Remainder Hold Handling
scenarios.description: Captured ₹800 of ₹1200, PARTIALLY_CAPTURED state, void remainder released hold cleanly.

scenarios.name: Early Webhook Arrival Race Resolution
scenarios.description: Stripe webhook arrives before sync auth, state moves to CAPTURED, sync handler resolves idempotently.

scenarios.name: Cascade Failure & Method-Fit Routing
scenarios.description: Preserves payment method constraints: UPI never routed to Card-only Stripe; Stripe 429 backoff respected.

scenarios.name: Refund on Already-Settled Payment
scenarios.description: Payment in SETTLED state refunded: SETTLED -> REFUND_INITIATED -> REFUNDED without balance corruption.

scenarios.name: Multi-Process Idempotency Race
scenarios.description: 5 simultaneous competing requests on identical key: exactly 1 payment created, 0 duplicate debits.

scenarios.name: Webhook Tampering & Signature Verification
scenarios.description: Tampered payload rejected with HTTP 401 WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, DB state preserved.

scenarios.name: Missing Settlements in Batch Reconciliation
scenarios.description: 5 missing settlements flagged as RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH, NO auto-refund, audit investigation logged.

scenarios.name: UPI Collect Request Expiry & Mandate Timeout
scenarios.description: Customer unapproved UPI collect mandate expires to AUTH_EXPIRED with 0 retries.

scenarios.name: Multi-Tenant Idempotency Collision
scenarios.description: Two merchants using identical UUID idempotency key succeed independently via composite primary key.

scenarios.name: Database Pool Exhaustion & Backpressure
scenarios.description: Bounded pool saturation handles backpressure gracefully without connection leak or process hang.

scenarios.name: State Machine Illegal Transition Protection
scenarios.description: CREATED -> REFUNDED jump rejected with 422, allowed transitions returned, REJECTED_TRANSITION logged.
